notes: Selective ribosome profiling: AP samples are TF affinity-purified ribosome footprints (IP_or_pulldown), Total samples are ribosome footprints. All samples one genotype (MC4100 delta-tig with pTig-TEV-Avi, IPTG), no control; genotype_class left out (deletion complemented by plasmid-borne tagged tig, unclear class). DSP1/DSP2 got 2 min chloramphenicol before harvest (harvest step, labelled abx_translation acute); filtration samples treatment none. rrna_removal only where 'rRNA subtracted' is stated. Oxygen/culture mode not stated.

base_medium.q: diluted to an OD600 of 0.02 in LB media

medium_class.q: in LB media supplemented with 100 µg/ml of carbenicillin

amino_acids_supplied.q: in LB media supplemented with 100 µg/ml of carbenicillin

growth_temperature.q: grown at 37°C until reaching an OD600 of 0.45

transcription_arrested.q: analysis of the interactions between nascent chains and the molecular chaperone Trigger Factor

mixed_organism.q: Examination of translation in the Gram-negative bacterium Escherichia coli

treatment.q: The culture was incubated with 100 µg/ml of chloramphenicol for 2 min

exposure.q: incubated with 100 µg/ml of chloramphenicol for 2 min

treatment.q: Cells were flash frozen in liquid nitrogen after the media was rapidly filtered

rrna_removal.q: The resulting cDNA was circulizarized, rRNA subtracted, and PCR amplified
